hero.lede: ApexLedger enforces double-entry integrity inside PostgreSQL — not in application code. Post journals, close periods, and read reports with an optional AI assistant. No cloud. No data leaves the host.

features.title: Built like a vault, runs like a tool.

doubleEntry.title: Database-enforced double entry
doubleEntry.body: Balance validation, posting, reversals, and period closes are PL/pgSQL functions. The engine refuses unbalanced entries at the storage layer — no application bug can corrupt the books.

immutable.title: Immutable ledger
immutable.body: UPDATE and DELETE privileges on journal tables are revoked at the database level. Corrections happen through reversing entries, preserving the full audit trail forever.

ai.title: Optional AI assistant
ai.body: Bring your own key (OpenAI) or run a local model (Ollama). The assistant records transactions through the same secured RPCs — it can never leave your entity or bypass role checks.

ui.title: Fast, dense UI
ui.body: A dark, keyboard-first interface with virtualized journals for thousands of rows, live debit/credit balance indicators, and a trial balance that proves itself.

setup.title: One-command setup
setup.body: apexledger init prepares the container, database, and migrations. A first-boot wizard creates your entity, admin, and fiscal calendar — no manual SQL.

backup.title: Auto-backup before anything
backup.body: apexledger backup dumps a timestamped, gzipped snapshot. Updates are opt-in and never install themselves.

rls.title: Row-Level Security
rls.body: Every table is entity-scoped. JWT claims are injected into the PostgreSQL session so policies evaluate the caller without trusting the application.

dual.title: Dual-layer defense
dual.body: Read endpoints filter by entity again at the application layer. Isolation holds even if a connection bypasses RLS.

roles.title: Roles in the engine
roles.body: Only finance roles can create or post journals — checked inside the database function, not just the API.
